blind.description: A long wooden shop counter with decorative raised wood panels along the front and sides. Set on top of the counter surface, from left to right, are: a brass balance scale with two hanging pans, four small white ceramic potion jars/bottles with colored labels (red and green stripes), a stone mortar and pestle, and a small wooden tier rack holding six small glass potion bottles in red, green, and amber colors. The surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and stylistically finished with smooth stylized textures and metallic sheen on the brass scales.
blind.from_above: A long rectangular wooden surface aligned horizontally, displaying from left to right the circular pans and beam of the brass balance scale, four round white bottle caps, a round grey mortar with a protruding pestle handle, and a wooden bottle rack containing six small colored circular bottle tops.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter stands roughly half the height of the figure (about 2.5 to 3 ft tall to the tabletop, slightly higher to the top of the scales), and about 6 ft long.

notes: Jars feature colored striped label bands.
